Quiet Evening — Entrust the day and rest in Him

You’re already welcome here—even heavy days can end with one honest breath; nothing here rushes you to peace.

Psalm 4:8 (KJV)
"I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety."
What are you carrying as the day ends? One breath of gratitude is enough.

— A quiet close to the day

Plain words: You can lie down in peace because the Lord keeps you safe through the night.

Tonight: You don’t have to carry the day into tomorrow. His safety is already around you.

So do this: Name one thing you’re releasing and whisper “Into Your hands.”

A gentle coloring moment for little ones before bed

When it fits the evening, draw a quiet moon over a peaceful house. Write the verse softly at the bottom. Talk together about how the Lord keeps us safe as we sleep.

Open Kids Coloring

Tiny KJV ref. Soft silver and amber tones. A few minutes of calm before rest.
